description: This file defines the 'Column' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling table columns in spreadsheet worksheets. It includes properties and methods for managing column attributes, formulas, and structured references.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a table column in a spreadsheet worksheet, with properties for index, filter button visibility, totals, formulas, and associated table. Includes methods for managing these properties and updating structured references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Column instance with a specified column identifier and optional table reference.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column's index label, e.g., 'A'.

methods.name: setColumnIndex
methods.description: Sets the column's index label, converting to uppercase and validating range if table is set.

methods.name: getShowFilterButton
methods.description: Returns whether the filter button is shown for this column.

methods.name: setShowFilterButton
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the filter button for this column.

methods.name: getTotalsRowLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the totals row.

methods.name: setTotalsRowLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the totals row.

methods.name: getTotalsRowFunction
methods.description: Returns the function used in the totals row.

methods.name: setTotalsRowFunction
methods.description: Sets the function used in the totals row.

methods.name: getTotalsRowFormula
methods.description: Returns the formula for the totals row.

methods.name: setTotalsRowFormula
methods.description: Sets the formula for the totals row.

methods.name: getColumnFormula
methods.description: Returns the formula associated with this column.

methods.name: setColumnFormula
methods.description: Sets the formula for this column.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the Table object associated with this column.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Associates this column with a Table object.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferences
methods.description: Static method to update structured references in formulas and named ranges when a table's title changes.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferencesInCells
methods.description: Private static method to update formulas in worksheet cells containing structured references.

methods.name: updateStructuredReferencesInNamedFormulae
methods.description: Private static method to update formulas in named ranges containing structured references.
